scope.generator_identity: exact numeric equality on retained generator_calls, ground-truth focal, and chart yaw against R015

supported: In this exact deterministic author-generator batch, every unassigned UP1/UP2 diagnostic output coincides with zero returned real-root slots.
The unchanged native residual selector chose a nonpositive focal estimate despite an available finite positive candidate in 12 UP1 and 84 UP2 problems.
The status sidecar separates the frozen mechanism categories with exact accounting and independent selector replay.
not_supported: The diagnostic NaN sentinel is behavior-equivalent to the author's undefined unassigned read.
A positivity-aware selector is already a quality improvement; alternative pose/error quality was not retained and no intervention ran.
inconclusive: Whether positivity-aware selection improves camera-pose and focal metrics on the 96 affected selection cases.
Whether zero-root cases can be repaired by a numerical root or polynomial treatment rather than only made safe.
repaired: Runner database recovery and post-hoc frozen-plan binding with full disclosure.

limitations: The batch is one deterministic synthetic author-generator stream, not a real-data benchmark.
Candidate translations and full poses were not retained, so alternative-candidate pose quality cannot be reconstructed post hoc.
Zero returned slots are an implementation observation, not proof that the mathematical quartic has no real root.
next_action: Start a separate gravity-pose-positive-selector-v1 intervention: retain full pose/error for the lowest-residual finite positive candidate, compare it against the unchanged native selector on the exact affected cases, and keep zero-root/no-positive cases as controls.
